description: JSTE traffic simulation benchmark dataset archive provides JSTE's archive of benchmark data intended for validation of traffic simulation models. The provider is Japan Society of Traffic Engineers. Geographical and temporal coverage: The Japanese professional association describes datasets for comparing simulated traffic with observed conditions. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The first HTTP extraction used the wrong character encoding. Correctly decoded metadata are retained; individual archives were not downloaded. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
